name: Dwarf
flavor: Raised underground on discipline, ale, and the belief that a well built wall outlasts a clever plan. Comfortable in heavy armor, handy with an axe.

subraces.label: Hill Dwarf
subraces.blurb: Raised with an instinct for omens and a body that shrugs off wounds other people are still nursing. (Extra hit points, and more every level.)

subraces.label: Mountain Dwarf
subraces.blurb: Raised in a hold that measured you by how much steel you could carry and still swing a hammer. (A feel for heavier armor.)

racialDetail.prompt: Every dwarf apprentices to something before they ever lift a weapon in anger. What did you learn?
racialDetail.mechanicNote: This is where your tool proficiency comes from.

options.label: Smith's tools
options.blurb: You learned to shape metal before you learned to fight.

options.label: Brewer's supplies
options.blurb: You learned what makes a hall worth coming back to.

options.label: Mason's tools
options.blurb: You learned how stone remembers everything built into it.

name: Elf
flavor: Grew up in a culture that treats swordplay and spellcraft as the same kind of art, one worth centuries of practice. Quick, precise, unhurried.

subraces.label: High Elf
subraces.blurb: Raised around old books and older magic, the kind who picked up a spell before anyone taught you one on purpose. (A cantrip of your choice, and a second language.)

subraces.label: Wood Elf
subraces.blurb: Raised somewhere the trees outnumbered the people, and you learned to move through both without being noticed. (Quicker on your feet, harder to spot in the open.)

racialDetail.prompt: What being an elf already means
racialDetail.text: You don't sleep, not really. Four hours of trance does what a human needs eight for, and you've spent the extra hours of every night of your life half dreaming, half watching. Charm magic slides off you more easily than it should, and your eyes find what others miss in a dim room.
racialDetail.mechanicNote: Trance, Fey Ancestry, Darkvision, Keen Senses, if you're keeping score.

name: Halfling
flavor: Small, stubborn, and loyal to hearth and neighbor above all else. Luckier than they have any right to be.

subraces.label: Lightfoot Halfling
subraces.blurb: Raised to be underestimated, and to use that. You slip past notice even standing right next to someone. (You can hide behind almost anyone bigger than you.)

subraces.label: Stout Halfling
subraces.blurb: Raised on the idea that the road is safer than it looks, provided you're too stubborn to be poisoned by it. (Better odds against poison.)

racialDetail.prompt: What being a halfling already means
racialDetail.text: You've had narrower misses than you can explain, and less fear than makes sense for someone your size. People underestimate you right up until it costs them.

name: Human
flavor: No particular gift, no particular curse. What you become is entirely up to how you train.

racialDetail.prompt: Common was never the only thing you picked up, listening at crossroads and market stalls.
racialDetail.mechanicNote: This becomes the second language on your record.

options.label: Dwarvish
options.blurb: Hard consonants, said like they're meant.

options.label: Elvish
options.blurb: Picked up from travelers, songs more than sentences.

options.label: Orc
options.blurb: Blunt and useful, learned somewhere you'd rather not explain.

options.label: Draconic
options.blurb: Old and harsh, mostly found in books nobody else wanted to read.

name: Dragonborn
flavor: Descended from dragons and raised to prove it. Proud, blunt, and inclined to make a stand rather than a retreat.

racialDetail.prompt: Every dragonborn carries the color of one dragon in their blood, whether they've ever breathed fire or not.
racialDetail.mechanicNote: This sets the damage type of your breath weapon.

options.label: Black
options.blurb: Corrosive and patient, a color that wears things down slowly. Acid.

options.label: Blue
options.blurb: Sharp and sudden, a color that arrives before the sound does. Lightning.

options.label: Brass
options.blurb: Talkative ancestry, if the stories about it are true. Fire.

options.label: Bronze
options.blurb: Coastal blood, drawn to open water. Lightning.

options.label: Copper
options.blurb: A trickster's color, fond of a long game. Acid.

options.label: Gold
options.blurb: The color nobility likes to claim for itself. Fire.

options.label: Green
options.blurb: Quiet and cunning, patient in a different way than black. Poison.

options.label: Red
options.blurb: The color everyone already has an opinion about. Fire.

options.label: Silver
options.blurb: Cold and clear, the color of a line that holds. Cold.

options.label: White
options.blurb: The color of somewhere nobody chooses to live. Cold.

name: Gnome
flavor: Curious to a fault, half convinced every locked door hides a puzzle worth solving. Magic bounces off a gnome's mind more than it should.

subraces.label: Rock Gnome
subraces.blurb: Raised with a workbench instead of a crib, more or less. You'd built something small and clever before you'd built anything that mattered. (Comes with a tiny clockwork device of your choosing.)

subraces.label: Forest Gnome
subraces.blurb: Raised on the edge of the woods, close enough to talk to whatever was living in them. (A knack for small illusions and small animals.)

racialDetail.prompt: What being a gnome already means
racialDetail.text: Enchantments that would flatten a bigger mind tend to slide right past yours. You see fine in the dark, and you've never met a locked mechanism you didn't want to take apart.

name: Half-Elf
flavor: Belongs fully to neither human nor elven society, and made peace with that by getting good at reading a room and holding a group together.

racialDetail.prompt: Which world mistakes you for one of its own, first?
racialDetail.mechanicNote: Flavor only, the two-skills-of-your-choice trait this echoes isn't tracked in this build.

options.label: Human towns
options.blurb: You pass, mostly, until someone asks the wrong question.

options.label: Elven circles
options.blurb: Tolerated there, in a way that never quite becomes belonging.

name: Half-Orc
flavor: Built to take a hit and keep coming. Orcish blood runs hot, but the will not to let it run the show runs hotter.

racialDetail.prompt: What being a half-orc already means
racialDetail.text: You've been left for dead before and gotten back up anyway. When you hit something hard it tends to stay hit, and most people decide not to test that twice.

name: Tiefling
flavor: Carries an infernal bloodline whether it's wanted or not, and learned early to rely on wit and will rather than anyone else's good opinion.

racialDetail.prompt: What being a tiefling already means
racialDetail.text: Fire has never bothered you the way it bothers everyone else, and your eyes do fine in the dark your blood came from. People decided what you were before you said a word, most of your life. You stopped waiting for them to change their minds.
